limitations: All readiness inputs, dependency observations, identities, clocks, and traces are synthetic; no Azure endpoint or management API is contacted.
The required pool is explicit. Optional instances are excluded rather than admitted or certified ready.
The aggregate sample is intentionally not a required route-validation check; actual route correctness is unknown.
One readiness snapshot does not prove a stable-readiness window, capacity, compatibility, authentication, user-journey continuity, or race-free real admission.
Actual user impact remains unknown in all five interruption categories; no transition success percentage is computed.
Original browser handle/stability limitations are preserved above. The continuation verified keyboard Reset, while mobile viewport and alternate-browser checks remain unverified.
Controller review/acceptance is separate from worker publication. No completion credit is self-awarded.
